title: Your first web page
summary: Every page starts from the same skeleton: doctype, html, head and body.

quiz.q: Which element holds everything the visitor can **see** on the page?
quiz.explain: `<body>` holds the visible content. `<head>` holds information about the page, and `<html>` wraps both.
A closing tag repeats the element name after a slash: ``.

quiz.q: Put the lines of the page skeleton in the correct order.
quiz.explain: The doctype comes first, then `<html>`. The head comes before the body, and every element is closed in the reverse order it was opened.

quiz.q: Click the line that is wrong.
quiz.explain:
The paragraph is opened twice. The second `

` should be the closing tag `

`.

exercise.task:
Edit `index.html` so the page has a title, a main heading and a paragraph. - Add `My first page` inside ``. - Add `

Hello, web!

` inside ``. - Add a `

` paragraph of your own below the heading.
hints: The title goes inside the head. Start by adding a `<head>` element between `<html>` and `<body>`.
Inside `<head>` write `<title>` then the text then `</title>`. Inside `<body>` add the heading and the paragraph.

Hello, web!

Any sentence you like.

checks.hint: Put the title text between <title> and </title>.
